newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Spain not planning Argentine airline sale - minister.
newsitem.headline: Spain not planning Argentine airline sale - minister.

text.p: Spain has no plans to sell its stake in Aerolineas Argentinas, Spain's industry and energy minister said in an interview published Wednesday.
Spain will "continue to be involved in the operation, the management and the personality of the company," Industry and Energy Minister Josep Pique told the daily Clarin.

Spanish state-owned airline Iberia Lineas Aereas de Espana SA holds a 20 percent stake in Aerolineas, while the Spanish government itself owns around 45 percent through its 100 percent ownership of Iberia and through a holding company.
The Spanish government hopes to privatize Iberia between 1997 and 2000, Pique said.

"Aerolineas is not at the edges of the liberalization process that is affecting the whole airline industry. Therefore, there will be alliances, maybe share swaps between companies, but our involvement in Aerolineas, whatever the result of the negotiations, will continue," the minister said.
Spain is seeking new strategic alliances to strengthen the commercial base of Iberia and the other airlines in which it has interests such as Aerolineas.
